tam_evidence.quote: The conversational commerce software market for Indian MSMEs reached ₹420 crore in 2025, driven by WhatsApp Business adoption.

tam_note: Deck claim of ₹500 crore is supported by industry reports (median sourced figure: ₹420 crore; within 0.5x–2.0x range).

assumptions: TAM: ₹500 Crore (63M MSMEs total conversational commerce market claim)
SAM: ₹125 Crore (25% reachable segment — 15M active WhatsApp Business accounts)
SOM: ₹18.75 Crore (15% target market share of high-growth retail & D2C traders within 3 years)
assumptions.figure_text: Indian conversational commerce market projected to reach $1.2B by 2026
assumptions.quote: Indian conversational commerce ecosystem is expanding at 38% CAGR towards $1.2 billion

tam_note: Deck claims a ₹500 Cr TAM, whereas industry market research benchmarks Indian conversational commerce at ₹9,960 Cr ($1.2B), indicating the deck's TAM is either artificially constrained or significantly miscalculated.
